concerns_addressed: WhatsAppPayloadParser now resolves numeric, SKU, and exact-name product references through Product::purchasable, so inactive-supplier products cannot enter WhatsApp order creation while supplier-less legacy products remain resolvable.

The added regression test verifies rejected-message status, unchanged stock, no order for an inactive supplier product, and successful ordering of a supplier-less product; existing signature, sender, retry, idempotency, and notification requirements are not weakened.
The correction closes the same supplier-eligibility boundary for WhatsApp that the REST order path enforces, removing the prior cross-task bypass.

strengths: The parser reuses the shared purchasable scope instead of duplicating supplier eligibility rules, while retaining its existing exact-reference and ambiguity validation.
The correction is a minimal two-line integration plus focused regression coverage and does not introduce complex chatbot behavior or alter webhook transaction/idempotency handling.

issues.description: The optional PostgreSQL concurrency suite is explicit and correctly skips when DB_CONNECTION=pgsql/pdo_pgsql or the test database is unavailable. This environment has no pdo_pgsql and the Docker daemon is unavailable, so the two real PostgreSQL worker races could not be executed here; SQL grammar, transaction/lock flow, and test setup remain inspected and sound.
